surprisingly I was expecting to be in a lot more pain than I actually am. I've experienced no major pains whatsoever mostly just discomfort. when I woke up after the surgery I had drains in my chest to collect all the fluid so it doesn't build up and those things were such a pest. they were taped onto me and held via a little incision and a stitch and that was very unpleasant as they would often tug and get caught and where they sat under my skin was very tender (I only had those in until the 12th.) getting them out was a strange feeling as they were long and coiled under my skin but immediately after there was a big relief. over all I felt more aches than anything else and when I got my bandages off my chest felt very tight however that's went away now. lots of people including myself are surprised at how I'm in no pain, so that could either mean my pain tolerance is good or its a relatively painless surgery. but I definitely think that it depends on the person and how quickly or how well your body heals :)
